snippet.title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes | Crisis System Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes’ Demo is available NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535950/Battlestar_Galactica_Scattered_Hopes/

Welcome back, Commander. Can you keep your head in a Crisis? Today’s Deep Dive takes you through the Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes’ all-new Crisis System, so tune in, and get prepared for the challenges that await!

The Crisis System has been designed to make each isolated Commander feel the true weight of leadership. Commanding a fleet  is a heavy burden, and its one which falls to you as you lead your fleet of survivors back to the Battlestar Galactica.

On the journey you’ll face complex emergencies, threatening the safety, stability and survival of your fleet. These Crises will test you, your lieutenants, the civilians and even the masked Cylons hiding within the fleet.
Join us today for a Deep Dive into the Crisis System, and learn how a Crisis is made, how you can manage it, and the repercussions of your decisions on the Fleet.

Stick around for more Dev Update and Deep Dive content, including a look into the Squadrons System - your way of protecting the Fleet in the face of overwhelming Cylon attack.

Stay updated and join the Fleet’s HQ on social media:
💫 X - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://x.com/playbsg 
💫 Facebook - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://www.facebook.com/playbsg 
💫 Discord - Alt Shift : https://discordapp.com/invite/jgdQ7XY
